title: Trophic Levels and Transfer of Biomass

flashcard_questions.q: The stages in a food chain, numbered from level 1 (producers) upwards to top predators.
The total mass of living material in an organism or at a particular trophic level.
Organisms that make their own food by photosynthesis, such as green plants and algae.

flashcard_questions.a: Herbivores that eat producers — the first consumers in a food chain.
Carnivores or omnivores that eat primary consumers.
